- GRC Manager: Approve up to $185k cap for countering. Please include a one-paragraph business justification in the offer note that highlights regulatory timelines (payments compliance audit in Q3) to support the higher comp if asked later.
- GRC Sr. Analyst: Approved.
- SecEng Lead (REQ-7844): I do not have authority to approve a band exception to $240k for SecEng senior technical roles — this needs VP of Engineering signoff. Please route that approval to Laura. Also confirm whether these hires are headcount swap vs. incremental; if incremental, we'll need an updated headcount delta in the workback doc for finance before finalizing.
